items.question: How is the goddess addressed as sovereign over sky-moving beings in the Kali age?
premises: The address is situated in the time of the Kali age.
The goddess is invoked directly as devi.
The goddess is characterized as moving in the sky.
The goddess is hailed as leader of a hundred.
items.inference: The verse praises the goddess as the supreme leader of numerous sky-moving beings during the Kali age.
uncertainties: Whether śata-nāyike refers to a hundred leaders or leadership over hundreds is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: O Goddess, in the age of Kali, you who move through the sky, leader of hundreds, I honor you.
